purpose: Register candidate reference sources and clarify what each can and cannot validate.
rules: A candidate reference is not automatically ground truth.
A source must be independent of model inputs for held-out target evaluation.
A reference that measures one component already used in the index is component-level evidence, not independent validation of the whole index.
Spatial and temporal support must be documented before joining a reference to a model output.
Only reviewed records with an explicit, defensible target definition may be approved for predictive evaluation.

targets.name: NASA SMAP surface soil moisture
targets.recommended_use: Compare the direction and timing of the Open-Meteo soil-moisture component against a separate satellite retrieval after quality filtering and spatial-temporal alignment.
targets.not_suitable_for: Treating this alone as fully independent ground truth for the composite water-stress index, because soil moisture is already one of the index components.
targets.source_notes: NASA's SMAP L3 Enhanced product is a satellite-derived daily soil-moisture estimate at about 9 km. Product version, quality flags, overpass, land cover, and acquisition date must be recorded for any actual extraction.

targets.name: Central Ground Water Board water level observations
targets.recommended_use: Provide independent hydrological context or support a separately defined groundwater-stress outcome when the selected well, dates, and local relevance are documented.
targets.not_suitable_for: Calling groundwater depth direct ground truth for daily surface-soil or crop stress without a defensible hydrological/agronomic relationship.
targets.source_notes: CGWB describes a national monitoring network with periodic measurements and some higher-frequency telemetry stations. Actual coverage and cadence vary by station and dataset.

targets.name: Official, documented drought assessment
targets.recommended_use: Potential independent outcome for an administrative-area/season classification task if an authoritative record, method, dates, and geographic unit are available.
targets.not_suitable_for: Daily location-level labels unless the source actually supports that temporal and spatial resolution.
targets.source_notes: India's drought management manual discusses assessment across rainfall, vegetation, water, crop, and other indicator groups. Access to a consistent machine-readable outcome series must be confirmed before this is used as a target.

targets.name: Local field water-stress assessment
targets.recommended_use: Potentially strong local validation when observations use a documented protocol, sampling plan, assessor guidance, location/time metadata, and independent quality review.
targets.not_suitable_for: Evaluation from anecdotal or retrospectively assigned labels without documented criteria.
targets.source_notes: Requires data collection and explicit consent/permissions where applicable; no field observations are currently included in this repository.

targets.name: Karnataka Ground Water Department telemetry observations
targets.recommended_use: Review station-level groundwater depth, time coverage, and location metadata for hydrological context or a separately defined groundwater-stress task.
targets.not_suitable_for: Treating these station readings as direct daily ground truth for the composite soil/crop water-stress index without a documented and validated relationship.
targets.source_notes: Karnataka Ground Water Department dataset exposed by NWDP. Source timezone, station coordinates, datum, cadence, missingness and licence terms require review. The connector writes local raw data and an auditable quality report; no source rows are packaged in Git.
